candidateProducts.method: Publisher dissolves HydroBASINS highest-level polygons (level 12), checks against coarser levels; named major rivers and HydroRIVERS-derived networks are separate publisher layers. This is a distinct derived product, not a Figshare mirror.

candidateProducts.globalBytes: Publisher rounded sizes: 130 MB GeoJSON /117 MB Shapefile; exact bytes and selected-subset size unknown.

notAdopted.name: EEA ECRINS FunctionalRiverBasinDistricts
notAdopted.reason: Functional adjustment of Water Framework Directive river basin districts, which are not natural hydrological entities. Must not be named as the 7 river basins without FEC topology/gazetteer verification.

notAdopted.name: Standalone HydroBASINS/HydroRIVERS
notAdopted.reason: Primary pages confirm HydroATLAS includes the same geometry. Not used as an alternate route to reacquire denied BasinATLAS/RiverATLAS geometry. License is HydroSHEDS custom license with redistribution and attribution terms, not CC BY4.0.
